(i) all existing HG models predict the same qualitative behavior for the baryonic density, namely, a rapid increase in the baryonic number density as a function of temperature, followed by a slow decrease; and (ii) the baryonic densities in the HG phase obtained in these models are consistent with the results of the previous paper, which were obtained using a different method.
